data.title: Kurdish PKK criticises Turkey bill on fate of its fighters
data.description: ISTANBUL - Outlawed Kurdish group the PKK on Sunday criticised a proposed Turkish law setting out the fate of its fighters after disarmament, a day before parliament prepares to consider it.

data.title: Bodies hanging from bridge revive violence in once-calm town in Mexico
data.description: POZOS DE GAMBOA (MEXICO) - Horrific drug violence plagued the Mexican state of Zacatecas for years, until relative calm set in. Then one morning in July this small town woke up to find five bodies dangling from a bridge -- a grim calling card that showed the bloodshed never really left.

data.title: Five dead in new Russia, Ukraine strikes
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian strikes killed two people and wounded dozens across Ukraine overnight Saturday and Sunday, while a Ukrainian drone attack killed three people in Russia's Belgorod region.

data.title: Students, teachers mourn girl killed in Thailand school shooting
data.description: BANGKOK - Dozens of bereaved students, parents and teachers queued at a Buddhist temple in Thailand on Sunday to pray over the body of a 12-year-old girl, one of eight victims of a home and school shooting two days earlier.

data.title: Typhoon Dolphin makes landfall in China after flight cancellations, evacuations
data.description: BEIJING - Typhoon Dolphin made landfall in densely populated eastern China on Sunday, meteorological authorities said, after the storm triggered more than 1,000 flight cancellations, evacuations and a top-level alert.

data.title: Iran Guards say won't reopen Hormuz without US meeting all Tehran's conditions
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Sunday they would not reopen the Strait of Hormuz, vital to the world economy, until the United States met Tehran's conditions set out the day before, including compensation for war damages.

data.title: Indonesia closes national park as wildfire spreads
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian authorities have closed access to a national park on Java Island as firefighters battle a wildfire raging there for nearly a week.

data.title: ZXMoto leads China's charge to dominate the global motorbike market
data.description: CHONGQING, China - Zhang Xue wept with joy and furiously waved a Chinese flag as he watched his company's superbike scream across the finish line four seconds ahead of competitors in only its third world championship race.

data.title: Iran issues demands for reopening of Hormuz
data.description: DUBAI - Iran set preconditions on Saturday for a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, including compensation for war damages, complicating a potential deal to open the waterway essential to the world economy.

data.title: Japan nuclear debate unnerves proponents of pacifism
data.description: TOKYO - As Japan marks the anniversary of the 1945 atomic bombs, its leaders are pushing for a renewed debate on nuclear weapons in a challenge to the nation's long-time pacifist stance.

data.title: Afghanistan's gold rush upends lives and landscapes
data.description: SHIWA MINE, Afghanistan - In Afghanistan's northeastern Badakhshan province, dozens of excavators operate day and night to extract gold from the mountains where villagers and their livestock once roamed.

data.title: Lionel Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Jorge Messi, the father and agent of Lionel Messi, has died aged 68, the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner's childhood club Newell's Old Boys announced on Saturday.

data.title: Ukraine denies targeting Bulgaria as drone explodes near pipeline
data.description: SOFIA (BULGARIA) - Ukraine on Saturday denied targeting Bulgaria after a drone exploded close to the strategic Trans-Balkan gas pipeline linking Turkey to Ukraine near the Romanian border.

data.title: Bodies spotted on Nepal peak where five climbers went missing
data.description: KATHMANDU - ⁠Nepali rescue workers ​have spotted five bodies at a site where ​the same number of ‌climbers went missing last year, officials said on Saturday.

data.title: Drone explodes near gas pipeline in Bulgaria
data.description: SOFIA, Bulgaria - A drone that entered Bulgaria on Saturday exploded near the Romanian border and the Trans-Balkan gas pipeline there, which links Turkey to Ukraine, Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev announced.

data.title: Trump’s ex-lawyer confirmed as US attorney general
data.description: WASHINGTON - The US Senate confirmed President Donald Trump’s former personal lawyer Todd Blanche as attorney general early Saturday after Republican lawmakers shrugged off Democratic concerns over politicisation of the Department of Justice.

data.title: Tibet conference in Nepal pushed online
data.description: KATHMANDU - An international academic conference on Tibet due to take place in Nepal this month has been pushed online, organisers said on Saturday, calling it a ”worrying development”.

data.title: Zelensky visits Russian ally Serbia for talks
data.description: BELGRADE - President Volodymyr Zelensky was making his first official visit to Serbia — a rare European country still closely aligned with Moscow — on Saturday as Ukraine seeks to bolster international support in the face of intensifying Russian strikes.

data.title: Typhoon Dolphin hits Okinawa, China shuts ports
data.description: TOKYO - Typhoon Dolphin lashed southern Okinawa prefecture in Japan on Saturday, injuring five people and cutting power to 14,000 buildings, while China shut ports and ferry routes ahead of the storm’s expected arrival on its east coast.

data.title: ‘Cockroach’ movement keeps heat on Indian PM
data.description: NEW DELHI - Two weeks after youth-led protests forced India’s education minister to resign, Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government is grappling with the fallout from one of its toughest political challenges in years.

data.title: Flamboyant millionaire taking power in Colombia
data.description: CALI, Colombia - With a lucrative legal career and a variety of colorful business projects under his belt, Colombia's incoming president Abelardo de la Espriella now has grand plans to crush armed insurgents, cozy up to the United States and overhaul the system.

data.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italy as migrant showdown grows
data.description: MADRID - Spain announced on Friday it would introduce temporary border checks on travellers from Italy in response to Rome imposing similar measures after a mass migrant rush into Ceuta.
